messages.text: Hi When will my order be shipped? Shop····
I'll look that up.
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Looked something up in Shopify

That order is under a different email than the one you gave me, so I can't open it on that. Give me one detail that's on it, either the name it ships to or the postcode, and I'll pull the ship date straight away.
Herbert G. (address hidden)
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Ran warehouse.py (store-orders skill)

Thanks, Herbert, that matches. Your order Shop···· is paid, and the B30 plus Power Kit haven't shipped yet. We wrote to you on September 15 about the cooling redesign and the new batch windows. Your batch is still on its way to our EU warehouse, and your order ships as soon as it's checked in, which the current plan puts in the first week of November. You can follow that shipment to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sorry for the extra wait on this one.
Thank you I will use the link. I hope he arrives here the first week of November.
Used the chat-interview skill

Small thing so you're not caught out: the first week of November is when it leaves our warehouse, not when it lands with you. Delivery to (address hidden) takes a few days on top, and you'll get tracking by email as soon as the label is on the box.

Before you go, one thing: what made you pick the B30 back in July rather than one of the smaller units?
I'm interested in the hashrate I now have a minor with 4.8 th
Ran the power-cost calculator

That's a big jump: the B30 is about 30 TH/s, roughly six times what you're running now, in one box.

Before you go, one thing: is the B30 going to sit alongside your 4.8 TH unit, or replace it?
I use both together

Makes sense, that puts you near 35 TH/s on the same pool. Thanks for telling me, Herbert, it helps.

Your B30 and Power Kit are set, and you'll get tracking by email as soon as the box is labelled. Anything else you want me to check in the meantime?
No thanks that would be all I'm so curious

Understood, and I think you'll enjoy it once it's up. A copy of this chat comes to your email once we're done here.

Keep an eye on the shipment page, and if anything looks off when you set it up, just come back to us. Have a good weekend, Herbert.
Sorry if it takes a while with the answers I have to translate. Thank you, I wish you the same. Greetings Herbert

Kein P., Herbert, Sie können gerne auf Deutsch schreiben, das geht genauso gut.

Viele Grüße und ein schönes Wochenende.
Danke schön . Es hilft mir zu übersetzen da ich gerne auch ein bisschen mehr Englisch benutzen möchte

Your English reads very well, honestly. Write to us in whichever one you like, and I'll answer in the same.

Enjoy the weekend, Herbert, and good luck with the B30 once it lands.
All set then. Take care, Herbert.
Mach ich
Gerne, Herbert. Bis bald.
